# OnGuard Protection

> SLED-licensed NSW security company covering Sydney, the Hunter, South Coast and Canberra. Master Licence 000110094. Crowd control, static guards, mobile patrols and event operations.

OnGuard Protection deploys licensed operatives for venues, construction, commercial sites and events. Contact [0432 893 343](tel:+61432893343) or [admin@ogprotection.com.au](mailto:admin@ogprotection.com.au).
